title: 새 라이브러리
description: An app dialog (File ▸ New ▸ Library…): the Save window of a new library file in the open project (project, given whole). folder is a folder of the project ("" the project folder itself; the list comes with the dialog), fileName the file's name (.foliolibrary is added when it lacks it). Applying sends library action new; when the file exists the dialog stays open asking to replace it (dialogState.confirm), and applyDialog action replace replaces it. The result is the library (path, library, view), which the screen opens. library is the project-relative path of the library open in the window (it is not saved over); sort is the order the window lists assets in.
